_comment: Owner per-camera / per-rig settings registry. Source of truth for
modules/camera_registry.py, which loads this file at import time and
keeps a one-release parity brace against the retired hardcoded tables
(a divergence is a hard ImportError naming the key).
Keys starting with '_' are comments; consumers must ignore them.
'families' is ordered MOST-SPECIFIC-FIRST and the order is
load-bearing: anchored WCA prefixes, then anchored legacy prefixes,
then the delimiter-bounded zeuss/herc token. An unanchored 'herc'
test once ran first and would have beaten an anchored WCA prefix.
Migration state (2026-08-07, steps a-b of the cameras.json plan):
camera_registry loads this file; georeference_images.py MOUNTS,
geoall.py constants, wildscan/session.py OFFICIAL_CAMERAS and
modules/file_metadata_parser.py still carry their own copies, each
marked 'superseded-by modules/cameras.json' at the site. Pinned by
testing/test_rig_mounts.py.
Flight-log accuracy columns. Since 2026-08-07 these are the
DEFAULTS of real knobs, not literals:
modules/georeference/georeference_images.PRIOR_ACCURACY_DEFAULTS is
the one table, exposed as --g_pos_accuracy / --g_alt_accuracy /
--g_orientation_accuracy on the module and --pos-accuracy /
--alt-accuracy / --orientation-accuracy on geoall.py.
Position accuracy is END-TO-END PER-IMAGE UNCERTAINTY, not sensor
spec: claiming the sensor figure (1/1/0.1) measurably FRAGMENTS
solves (testing/PRIORS_DISTORTION_TEST_PLAN.md 'bow 2x2').
Orientation stays at HONEST 15 deg until the mounts are
ground-truthed: PD-0/PD-0b measured 3-5 deg claimed accuracy
FRAGMENTING the solve while 15 deg gained registration.
unknown_mount_pitch_accuracy_deg is null BY DESIGN: an UNKNOWN
mount gets NO pitch prior at all. It used to be 10.0, i.e. 'this
camera looks straight ahead' asserted at 10 deg confidence on a
mount nobody measured - the invention MOUNTS['wca_starboard']=null
exists to refuse (audit 2026-08-07). Pitch and Pitch Accuracy are
written EMPTY for those rows; yaw/roll still come from the nav.
Calibration/lens groups are per PHYSICAL camera, never per lens
type: Port and Starboard share a lens spec but are different units
with different real intrinsics. Groups matter because the WCA JPGs
are EXIF-identical (Z CAM E2-F6, no focal tag) - without the XMP
groups RealityScan cannot separate the cameras at all.
Priors are 'Approximate' throughout (owner directive 2026-07-25):
verified NOT to pin distortion at zero even with no coefficients
supplied; 'Unknown' gave the solver no wiggle-room hint at all.

cinema._comment: Focal 17.0 -> 16.0: owner-confirmed 2026-07-25 ('C=16'), corroborated by the solver's own median 16.37 mm 35-eq over 2,204 cameras.

voyis_left._provenance: UNVERIFIED - ON2026 Voyis stereo left eye. Group 5 extends the rig sequence (1-4 taken). Focal and distortion model unknown here; ON2026 priors are COLMAP-derived (external colmap_studio fact base). Not referenced by any family, so excluded from the runtime CAMERAS table until verified.

voyis_right._provenance: UNVERIFIED - ON2026 Voyis stereo right eye. Group 6 extends the rig sequence (1-4 taken). Focal and distortion model unknown here; ON2026 priors are COLMAP-derived (external colmap_studio fact base). Not referenced by any family, so excluded from the runtime CAMERAS table until verified.

families._comment: The family is the MOUNT identity, the camera the OPTICAL identity - deliberately separate: the same Cinema unit sits 10 deg down under legacy camlower names and 45 deg under WCA names, so keying geometry off the camera would silently change every legacy dataset by tens of degrees. Mount fields: fwd/lat/down = lever arm in metres (+ahead/+right/+below the vehicle reference point), pitch = camera down-tilt from the vehicle forward axis (deg), p_acc = claimed accuracy of that pitch prior (deg). A null mount means WARN, never zeros. WCA Port/Cinema lever arms VALIDATED on two independent metrically sound solves (bow c2, zone_2/PD-2b): C above P by +1.12 m and +1.03 m against the +1.00 m implied here; do NOT flatten them - the 0.22 m / 0.00 m FINDINGS figures came from the 0.175-scale hull and are scale-corrupted. WCA p_acc is 15 deg, not 3-5: tighter FRAGMENTS the solve (PD-0). timestamp_formats port the WCA/ZEUSS/WCA2025 constants; modules/file_metadata_parser.py accepts both forms for any family.

Starboard's mount has NEVER been measured. The owner excludes Starboard from photogrammetry, so this should not be reached - and if it is, the run must SAY SO rather than invent a zero lever arm and a 0 deg tilt. Inventing rig numbers is what produced the Port-1 m incident.
Zeuss appears under 'zeuss'/'HERC' names across both eras, hence era 'all' and a delimiter-bounded token instead of an anchored prefix.

_comment: DATA-ONLY section: no pipeline consumer yet. RealityScan has no
stereo-rig support (staff-confirmed through Aug 2025, COLMAP fact
F-20260723-27): rig scale must come from GCPs / distance
constraints / locked XMP, so nothing recorded here may be turned
into solver constraints.

on2026_voyis._axes_comment: OPEN owner decision (HANDOFF 2026-08-07 blocking question #2): is the ON2026 local Euclidean frame ENU or NED? Decides whether YPR needs converting. Settle it against the bundle-adjusted poses already in ON2026_final.rsproj before filling this in.
on2026_voyis._eyes_comment: Per-eye filename patterns from the Voyis rectified-pair naming (image_left_/image_right_, same timestamp - COLMAP fact F-20260722-01). ON2026 rendered names UNVERIFIED against M: - verify before any consumer keys off these.
on2026_voyis._accuracy_comment: 0.02 m / 90 deg is the production winner of the colmap_studio accuracy matrix (C-20260730-05/09; FINDINGS [ON2026] 2026-08-07): 0.02 m validated at 6.3 mm median prior residual, and tight 10 deg orientation priors were actively WORSE. Both are constant CLI defaults of export_rs_flightlog.py (--pos-acc / --ori-acc), not per-sample sigmas.
on2026_voyis._stereo_baseline_comment: DATA-ONLY and null until measured empirically on ON2026 imagery (median distance between per-frame left/right projection centers, per F-20260723-05; the 0.170 m figure on record is the RH0041/LilyJean rig). RealityScan cannot consume a baseline anyway - no stereo-rig support.
